## Experience

### Moidas | NIHPLOD Greater China Division — Digital Development Manager (Oct 2025 – Present)

Joined as an intern in Oct 2025 and worked full-time before graduation; converted to full-time in Jul 2026, reporting directly to the brand lead. As the division's first engineer, cold-started the brand's entire Greater China information systems and digital infrastructure from 0 to 1.

- Owned planning and delivery of the brand's Greater China digital product portfolio — 6+ core systems: official e-commerce site, unified authentication (SSO), AI skincare advisor, WeChat AI customer service, mini-program store, and authorization & verification platform.
- Established AI-assisted development workflows and design standards, reducing average delivery cycles by over 50% while ensuring parallel multi-project delivery.
- As technical lead, took in requirements from product and marketing teams and broke them down into schedules, owning requirement reviews and iteration cadence, supporting the brand's online retail channels (official e-commerce site + mini-program store) from 0 to launch.

### Shanghai Lingang Jinghong Security Technology Development Co., Ltd. — R&D Intern (Jul 2025 – Sep 2025)

- Independently delivered the company website end-to-end, from architecture and UI/UX design to production deployment.
- Completed an internal MVP campus patrol management platform via secondary development on the Unitree robot dog SDK, validating product feasibility.
- Drove the company's first internal adoption of AI Q&A tools and engaged with Baidu's official Enterprise Q&A team on business collaboration.

## Projects

### NIHPLOD China Official Digital Platform (Portfolio) — Nov 2025 – Present

Live: https://www.nihplod.cn, https://advisor.nihplod.cn, https://ba.nihplod.cn

As technical lead, drove the brand's Greater China digital product matrix from 0 to 1 — architecture design and compliant launch — spanning 6+ systems: the official e-commerce site, unified authentication (SSO), AI skincare advisor, WeChat AI customer service, WeChat mini-program store, and the authorization & verification platform, with 170K+ lines of hand-written code and 1,400+ automated test cases delivered in total — and connected the business loop of "skin analysis → personalized regimen → 7×24 AI advisor follow-up → repurchase" through unified accounts and profile data.

- Compliance & Operations Governance: Led ICP filing, privacy policy and user agreement drafting, and data compliance review to ensure compliant launches across systems; dynamically adjusted server resources based on traffic to optimize costs.

### NIHPLOD Official E-Commerce & Unified Authentication Platform — Nov 2025 – Present (iterating)

Live: https://www.nihplod.cn

- E-Commerce Loop: Built the brand's e-commerce main site with Next.js 16 + Prisma + PostgreSQL, covering dual-channel payments (WeChat Pay / Alipay) and refunds (idempotent async notifications), SF Express logistics, and membership points & coupon systems; aggregated multi-channel identities (WeChat, Douyin, phone OTP) into a unified account system — 121 API routes, 36 data models, and 824 test cases across the site.
- Unified Authentication (SSO): Built a self-hosted OAuth 2.0 / OIDC SSO — the main site acts as Authorization Server issuing RS256 JWTs, fully implementing the authorize / token / userinfo / introspect / revoke / end-session endpoints with PKCE, DPoP, and TOTP two-factor authentication; packaged and published npm SDKs (@nihplod/sso-sdk / @nihplod/sso-verify) for minute-level sub-project integration, with Token Introspection + Backchannel Logout for cross-domain SSO and global sign-out.
- Security Hardening: Supports secret rotation, token revocation (RFC 7009), and multi-instance blacklist sharing for an operable and auditable auth system.
- Interactive Experience: Implemented multi-step skincare ritual guides and immersive brand storytelling using Framer Motion + View Transitions, with integrated product drawer and cart synchronization, fully responsive across devices.

### AI Skincare Advisor — Jan 2026 – Present

Live: https://advisor.nihplod.cn

- AI Skin Analysis & Personalized Recommendations: Integrated qwen-vl / deepseek-vl vision LLMs for dual-channel (questionnaire + facial scan) skin analysis, with a custom rule engine scoring products against 8 skin-type personas — configurable via a visual admin console (zero-code adjustments for operations) — plus multi-channel e-commerce attribution links; led model integration and core API development, lifting consultation conversion by 30%.
- Growth & Virality Design: Designed a guest mode (device fingerprint + time-limited profiles) letting users complete skin analysis without registration, plus shareable poster generation and channel-fission attribution to drive social spreading; exported desensitized statistics to feed the brand's whitepaper and market insights, turning the tool into a brand data asset.
- AI Cost Engineering: Designed circuit breakers with daily/monthly token budget cutoffs, persisted per-call billing, and a model whitelist with fallback for AI invocations — fixing a duplicate-billing risk caused by 5xx retries; user reports follow 90-day rolling retention with hot/cold tiered archiving (desensitized summaries in the cold tier).
- Data Asset Loop: Designed a server-to-server authenticated API that hands off skin-analysis reports and skincare profiles with the session to WeChat AI advisors (session_id passthrough), turning one-off skin tests into continuously operable, repurchase-driving user data assets.

### WeChat AI Customer Service — Aug 2026

- Multi-Entry Messaging Gateway & Multi-Turn Sessions: Built with FastAPI + Redis + the DeepSeek LLM, unifying three message entry points (WeCom customer service, WeCom app, and WeChat Official Account); receiving user profiles handed off from the skin-analysis platform, with automatic skincare-profile accumulation across multi-turn dialogue (stage-goal tracking and re-evaluation reminders), guided order inquiries, and smart human handoff (keyword detection + service-hour windows + sticky agent assignment) — turning one-off inquiries into long-term companion-style engagement.
- Prompt & Knowledge-Base Engineering: Routed two agent personas (brand service / skincare advisor) with independent prompts and knowledge bases by service account; built a 44KB brand FAQ knowledge base in segments with keyword-matched on-demand injection and hot reload; dual-layer compliance guardrails via prompt-injection defense and advertising-law prohibited-word output filtering.
- Quality Assurance & Availability: Locked prompt iteration quality with 34 golden regression cases against the live LLM, backed by 340+ automated tests; exponential-backoff retries with timeout control for AI calls, with automatic in-memory degradation and scheduled reconnection on Redis failure; provided PII export/deletion endpoints (PIPL compliance); self-hosted on Linux + Nginx.

### NIHPLOD Full-Stack E-Commerce System (WeChat Mini-Program + H5 + Admin Console) — May 2026 – Present

- Full-Stack Commerce Loop: Built with uni-app + Vue 3 + Express 5 + Prisma + PostgreSQL (mini-program/H5 dual-end plus a standalone admin console), covering the full pipeline of WeChat Pay V3, refund chain, SF Express logistics, and SMS notifications; with coupons, points, and other marketing mechanics.
- Skin Profile Data Integration: Embedded the skin-analysis entry in the mini-program (web-view) to guide users through AI skin testing; analysis profiles are linked by phone number and synced back automatically, providing skin trends, historical reports, and daily skincare check-ins — turning analysis traffic into a private-domain, long-term operation asset along the "analysis → follow-up → repurchase" loop.
- Engineering & Security: Implemented RBAC, audit logging, and multi-tier rate limiting, plus a custom in-memory cache with request deduplication to prevent cache breakdown — 26 data models, 191 automated tests (including concurrent-ordering tests), deployed via multi-stage Docker builds.

### NIHPLOD Brand Authorization & Verification Platform — Apr 2026 – May 2026

Live: https://ba.nihplod.cn

- Authorization Review & Anti-Counterfeit Certificates: Built the dealer authorization system with Next.js + Prisma + PostgreSQL, implementing a multi-level review workflow (application → auditor review → manager issuance); Canvas-based synthesis of anti-counterfeit certificates with e-seal and dynamic QR codes (PNG/PDF download).
- Public Verification & Security: Public authenticity verification with three-tier fallback matching (exact → prefix → fuzzy, accelerated by pg_trgm indexes) and a counterfeit-report ticketing system; hardened with JWT blacklisting, database-persisted rate limiting, and full audit logging.

### Shanghai Lingang Jinghong Security Technology Website System — Jul 2025 – Sep 2025

Independently delivered (full-stack) · Live: https://www.lingangjh.com

- Full-Stack Development & Design Delivery: Independently built the company website end-to-end with Next.js plus a CMS backend for autonomous content management, and independently designed the visual system and interaction prototypes in Figma — first-screen load under 1.5s, fully responsive across devices.
- AI Q&A & Security Architecture: Locally deployed the Wenxin/Qwen LLM-powered Q&A assistant (Weknora) with a RAG retrieval pipeline, achieving answer accuracy above 85%; implemented JWT authentication, RLS data isolation, and CSP policies for data security and access control.
